Messages.Author: blackday
Messages.Body:
My friend brought this up so here goes:
In Church of the Order of St. Blaise reads as follows "Tap this card to add one counter to a location you control that uses counters."
The location ALAMUT "If an Assamite you control successfully bleeds another Methuselah, put the pool lost by that Methuselah on this card. During a political action, you may burn X blood from this card to give a vampire you control X votes for that referendum."
My question is does the Church add counters to the Alamut, i was thinking no as there is no mention of counters in the card Alamut. But i thought better to ask you regarding this ruling.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
Pool are blood counters (Rulebook 1.2.2).
"Blood" refers to blood counters (Rules Glossary).

The Church would add blood counters on Alamut.
See also  [LSJ 20050203] .

Tags: Church of the Order of St. Blaise Alamut
